dashboard.label: TA-zfspool Metrics
dashboard.description: Index-time metrics over index=metrics (sourcetype zfspool:metrics); series prefixed 'zfspool.'.

search.query: index=main sourcetype="ta_license:status" app="TA-zfspool" [| rest /services/server/info | eval host=splunk_server | fields host] earliest=-3h | stats latest(status) as st | eval value=if(st=="active","Licensed","Unlicensed") | table value

panel.html: This host is licensed for TA-zfspool. Thanks for supporting BentleyPC development!

panel.title: Commercial use of TA-zfspool requires a paid license (evaluation, personal, lab use free)

search.query: | makeresults | eval buy="Buy License at bentleypc.com/TA-zfspool", terms="License and Terms at bentleypc.com/TA-zfspool/LICENSE.html" | fields buy terms

panel.title: License status (click "Open License Setup page" to paste your key)

search.query: index=main sourcetype="ta_license:status" latest=now earliest=-48h | stats latest(_time) as seen, latest(status) as status, latest(message) as note by host | eval last_reported=strftime(seen,"%F %H:%M"), setup="Open License Setup page - paste your key" | append [ | makeresults | eval host="this deployment", status="no data yet", note="beacon reports hourly once a key is set", last_reported="n/a", setup="Open License Setup page - paste your key" ] | table host status last_reported note setup | sort host

panel.title: All zfspool.* series (pools, subsystems, per-array counts)

search.query: | mstats avg("zfspool.*") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | rename v* as "zfspool.*"
| mstats avg("zfspool.md_*_active_disks") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | rename v* as "zfspool.md_*_active_disks"
| mstats avg("zfspool.md_*_required_disks") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | rename v* as "zfspool.md_*_required_disks"
| mstats avg("zfspool.md_*_degraded") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | rename v* as "zfspool.md_*_degraded"
| mstats avg("zfspool.md_*_recovery_pct") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | rename v* as "zfspool.md_*_recovery_pct"
